data.description: An adamantine golem's slam attacks threaten a critical hit on a 19 or 20.  In addition, whenever an adamantine golem scores a critical hit, it deals 6d10+%1 points of damage to the target's armor or shield in addition to the normal damage, as if it had also made a successful sunder combat maneuver.
data.name: Destructive Strike
